status.text: Written Jul 1, 2040, 12:00 PM, from the export of May 6, 2040.

because.label: What it reads
because.value: The standings, injuries, the farm, contracts, the trading block, finances, key dates and how current the data is.

written.text: Written by AI from Pennant's figures. It decides nothing.

because.label: What it was given
because.value: The standings, injuries, the farm as Minor League Operations describes it, contracts, the trading block, finances, key dates and how current the data is, from Pennant's own reports.

because.label: What it is
because.value: Writing about Pennant's figures, for reading. It decides nothing, and the decision is yours.

unknown: An AI can be wrong about what it reads; the figures in Pennant's reports are Pennant's own.
wouldChange: Write a new briefing, after a newer export.

off.text: AI is off. Everything else in Pennant works without it.

because.label: Why
because.value: No Anthropic (Claude) key set. Open Settings and add your key — you can get one at console.claude.com.

because.label: What still works
because.value: The Morning Report, the desk and every department's report are worked out by Pennant itself. The briefing is only written from them by an AI.

off.hint: Add a key in Settings to have a briefing written
